objective: Generate an original, solvable FIRST-CHAPTER candidate sequence and integrate a SEPARATE playable geometric-occupancy preview into the existing game stack before commissioning missing animal art; existing first level and its approved artwork must remain unchanged.

reference_research.purpose: Internal analysis of design distributions/solver conventions, not release-level coordinates.
reference_research.research_zip: Dogs_Geometry_Research_Package(1).zip (conversation attachment, NOT automatically present on Codex local Windows)
reference_research.verified_structure: 80 levels,30 mobile shapes, 21 blocker catalog entries including 20 irregular+single, and solver rule specification
reference_research.access_policy: Do not assume this chat attachment is in local Codex workspace. Implement against original shape metadata already in GitHub; importing research zip is optional and never a blocker. No level JSON from the reference is to be copied into release data.

locked_design.reference_level: Keep human-accepted first-level 5x4 6+4+6+4 exactly unchanged; it is a calibration fixture not newly generated content.
locked_design.generation_strategy: Use 80-level reference research for abstract complexity/distribution statistics only. Build original seeded constructive board/obstacle/whole-piece configurations and exact-cover verify them. No importing specific DOGS board instances or copying sequences.
locked_design.board_policy: Support configurable rectangular boards, explicit blockers and generated levels with board sizes independently defined; the first-level background has a baked 5x4 grid and CANNOT serve as the generic background for arbitrary boards. Use neutral programmatic preview background/board on a separate chapter-preview route. Keep first-level scene unmodified.
locked_design.legal_pieces: Each animal is ONE atomic draggable piece. Multiple instances of same approved sprite are allowed. Only quarter-turn rotations, no reflections; dedupe normalized orientations.
locked_design.seed: Every generated result records deterministic PRNG seed and generator version; replay must produce the exact same canonical board signature.
locked_design.deduplication: Within generated candidates canonicalize board occupancy/fixed geometry and shape-instance assignments; treat repeated indistinguishable animals as interchangeable. Do not claim geometric isomorphism dedup across 90deg board rotation/reflection without explicit implementation. Log what equivalence relation is actually used.
locked_design.difficulty: For V0.1 collect movable-piece count, distinct shape count, rotations required by example solution, fixed area, exact-cover solution count and branching/placement indicators. These are proxies, NOT proven human difficulty; avoid arbitrary pass/fail cutoffs.
locked_design.release_constraint: Geometry preview is intentionally playable with whole-shape placeholders and can receive USER gameplay QA as level-design proof. Release requires approved animal art, background fit and full G1-G4 afterward; do not call preview a finished release.
locked_design.initial_allowed_shapes_note: These two approved sprites may appear when an exact shape match exists, but they DO NOT restrict the geometry prototype shape set.
locked_design.shape_supply: Finite set of original polyomino shapes (4-neighbor connected; optional 2-8 cells with controlled count); placeholders display WHOLE PIECE occupied cells as a unified draggable outline with consistent color/ID, never animal body fragments. Animal assets are added later and must match shape precisely.

build_scope: Create an offline seeded generator with curated small original shape catalog (not just panda and rabbit); board geometry, fixed occupied blockers and piece counts must match exactly; support same shape multiple instances and quarter turns without mirror.

Generate and curate an ordered first-chapter PREVIEW of 8 playable candidate levels (provisional, not a frozen release quantity). If 8 cannot provide meaningful variety, report limitation rather than invent useless levels. Maintain at least 12 candidate JSONs where feasible for selection.

Integrate a separate browser-accessible playable chapter preview using existing core, with whole-colored polyomino silhouettes (each piece one atomic draggable object) for sprites not yet produced; completed panda/rabbit may reuse existing PNG if shape matches.

Preview supports start/level progress, left-pointer drag, right-click rotate (including while dragging), invalid-drop rollback, pickup/reposition, R reset, exact-cover win, NEXT transitions across preview levels, end-of-chapter and replay. Do not add large new UI framework.
Show one explicit note '几何关卡试玩版｜未完成动物素材' to avoid confusing preview with published art, and keep natural controls; lay out whole pieces left/right of board, not a permanent right-only tray.

Configure board dimensions per level and ensure preview uses PROGRAMMATIC grids and separate neutral environment instead of first-level baked 5x4 background; viewport regression at 1280x720,1024x768,800x600.

Implement exact-cover solver with reproducible seeds, proof solutions, full-vs-capped counts labelled, shape symmetry and repeated-identical-piece dedup, canonical JSON signatures to suppress duplicates.
Provide level data schema with stable shape_id, piece_id, occupied_cells, board w/h, blocked cells, optional art_asset_id; do not couple runtime logic to PNG existence.

Computer/Playwright tests must navigate 8-level chapter preview via real mouse actions, validate completion and correct transition, reset/invalid rollback/rotation, and unchanged prior first-level regression. Gather screenshot(s) and a concise known limits report.
Do not make or regenerate new animal sprites, do not build all 80 levels or copy original DOGS levels, do not change production contract.

output.code_root: tools/level_generator/ (or minimal justified existing compatible path)
output.human_review: DESIGN chooses what content to make; HUMAN later approves major chapter content scope and visual/gameplay experience

acceptance: At least 12 unique original level candidates if possible and a curated ordered 8-level clickable preview; justify any unavoidable smaller count.
Every preview level playable from start to NEXT or chapter end using REAL browser drag/rotation with atomic whole geometry pieces; no faked game-state completion.
All cells covered exactly and collisions/blockers properly enforced; repeating shapes are distinct objects and legal 90° rotations only.
Unfinished animals represented ONLY by unified colored occupied-grid piece, not torn animal parts; art replacement later cannot alter logical occupied_cells.
Current 5x4 human-approved first level, original background, panda and rabbit bytes remain unchanged. New multi-board preview does NOT overlay its grids on baked 5x4 art.
Board and side staging fit in 1280x720,1024x768,800x600; nothing unreachable due to scrolling or viewport scaling.
Deterministic seeds, deduping and exact-cover reports reproducible; difficulty metrics explicitly proxies only.
All returned candidates are original; no source DOGS level layouts/assets in production.
Document browser preview opening command/link, G4 preview testing, known shortcomings and handoff; not marked RELEASE_READY.
next_owner_action: CODEX implement original level generator AND 8-level browser playable whole-piece geometric preview; do not stop at candidate JSON. Preserve existing 1st level. Submit screenshots, browser QA, dedup/solution evidence and Git commits so DESIGN/HUMAN can play the sequence before requesting any more animal art.
